description: Blocks a raw `gh pr merge` (incl. `--admin`) that bypasses the ship gate. `gh ship <PR>` merges only on green CI + required screenshots; a raw merge skips both. Allows `gh ship`/`pr-ship.sh` and non-merge `gh pr` subcommands. Escape hatch: ALLOW_RAW_PR_MERGE=1 + ALLOW_RAW_PR_MERGE_REASON='why', or an inline `# no-ship-guard: why` sentinel. on_error=closed: if the check itself fails, deny rather than let a raw merge through.
